# Editorial review queue

## Unresolved candidates (15)

Each entry below received a review attempt. These are not project recommendations: the notes identify what access, completeness, credibility or safety question still needs resolution. A timeout or bot block alone does not establish a broken link or paywall.

- [Arduino Project Hub](catalogue-details.md#arduino-project-hub) — The public hub distinguishes tutorials, showcases and teardowns. No complete representative community tutorial was inspected, so hosting and popularity alone do not justify a checked recommendation.
- [Canon Creative Park](catalogue-details.md#canon-creative-park) — Browser inspection found Canon ID sign-in and the official help now says printing requires Canon PRINT. The former unrestricted-PDF assumption is unsupported. A compatible printing workflow and access to a complete pattern remain untested.
- [Crafts Council — Family Workshops](catalogue-details.md#crafts-council-family-workshops) — The primary-age resource page returned an access block. Official indexed text identifies downloadable home/classroom activities, but complete worksheets and the age-specific tool/supervision notes remain uninspected.
- [Crafts Council — Free Craft PDFs](catalogue-details.md#crafts-council-free-craft-pdfs) — The all-ages resource page returned an access block. Official search identifies downloadable activities, including kite making, but the linked complete worksheet still needs direct inspection.
- [Crafty Time with Dave](catalogue-details.md#crafty-time-with-dave) — The maker’s miniature-project homepage is readable, but the representative recycled log-cabin tutorial failed retrieval. The complete free build and its tool list remain to be checked.
- [Emma Tildesley — Oriental Lily Watercolour](catalogue-details.md#emma-tildesley-oriental-lily-watercolour) — The artist explicitly targets painters with some watercolor experience, correcting the beginner implication. The blog links a purportedly free Patreon lesson, but that post could not be retrieved; account requirements and full video access remain unresolved.
- [iFixit — Laptop Cleaning Project](catalogue-details.md#ifixit-laptop-cleaning-project) — The six-step community guide is readable, but it does not address internal battery isolation before brushing the board/fan. Hold pending comparison with Lenovo’s exact-model service procedure and a clearer power/ESD safety review.
- [Instructables — Studio Projects](catalogue-details.md#instructables-studio-projects) — Both text retrieval and a browser attempt exposed no usable collection content. The student-project collection’s completeness and current free access could not be established; this is not evidence that every destination is broken.
- [Makers Making Change](catalogue-details.md#makers-making-change) — The assistive-device library is public, but project-file links require registration and agreement to its terms. The inspected IKEA utensil-handle example depends on discontinued cutlery, so it is not a reproducible current starter project.
- [Michaels — Free Projects](catalogue-details.md#michaels-free-projects) — The project hub advertises free instructions, but its beginner results returned an empty shell and a browser attempt returned Access Denied. Complete free project instructions could not be inspected; Creativebug classes are a separate offer.
- [Sculpd Clay School — Free Basics](catalogue-details.md#sculpd-clay-school-free-basics) — The regional Clay School URL could not be retrieved and targeted official-site search did not recover a verifiable course. Complete free lesson access, kit dependence and the current canonical address remain unresolved.
- [Sewing Doc Academy — Vintage Sewing Machine](catalogue-details.md#sewing-doc-academy-vintage-sewing-machine) — The legacy page advertises three hours of free vintage-machine instruction, but exposes image thumbnails without usable lesson links in text retrieval. Playback and account conditions remain unconfirmed; electrical checks require qualified help.
- [SolidCraft CAD Guide — Model Your First Part](catalogue-details.md#solidcraftcad-first-part-tutorial) — Contributor runs the guide website (disclosed in the pull request).
- [The Ceramic School — Air Dry Clay](catalogue-details.md#the-ceramic-school-air-dry-clay) — The Air Dry Clay Club index is readable, but the Happy Snail project failed retrieval and the linked Freebies page exposed no usable project content. Complete free instruction and the membership boundary remain unresolved.
- [The Dye Store — Learn Hub](catalogue-details.md#the-dye-store-learn-hub) — The five-technique T-shirt guide contains preparation, folding, dye placement and finish directions and labels its diagrams AI-generated. Creator experience and demonstrated results need a further credibility check before recommendation.

## Reviewed references

These sources are useful background, planning or discovery material. Their reference disposition is an editorial decision, not an unprocessed queue item.

- [Art Prof](catalogue-details.md#art-prof) — The free Art Dares archive offers creative prompts and examples, with optional dated submissions; the homepage also promotes paid Art Club. Retained as an assignment-discovery reference until a complete practical tutorial is sampled.
- [Cambridge University Botanic Garden — Dyes from Plants](catalogue-details.md#cambridge-university-botanic-garden-dyes-from-plants) — The botanic garden page describes its plant-dye trail, artist research, plant information and downloadable trail brochure. It is botanical context rather than a complete reproducible dyeing lesson.
- [Class Central — Crafts Courses](catalogue-details.md#class-central-crafts-courses) — This is a course-search/discovery service containing free and paid providers, rather than an original instructional resource. The index itself is public; each destination’s payment, registration and project content require separate review.
- [Cornell — Reuleaux Mechanisms](catalogue-details.md#cornell-reuleaux-mechanisms) — The university collection documents historical mechanisms and their operation. It is useful engineering background, not a reproducible set of beginner fabrication plans.
- [Cycling UK — Renovating an Old Bike](catalogue-details.md#cycling-uk-renovating-an-old-bike) — The article discusses restoration decisions, paint, parts compatibility and external technical references. It is useful planning context, not a complete model-specific bicycle rebuild procedure.
- [Fix-It Club — Repair Guides](catalogue-details.md#fix-it-club-repair-guides) — The public A–Z index mixes clothing and household troubleshooting with hazardous battery, appliance, vehicle and mains-equipment repairs. The attempted clothing walkthrough failed retrieval. Individual procedures need a safety/completeness review before recommendation.
- [iFixit — Electronics Soldering](catalogue-details.md#ifixit-electronics-soldering) — The current regional page combines a public Soldering 101 video and skills-guide links with FixHub tool sales. It is a soldering technique starting point, not a complete specific-device repair. The course/video was not reviewed in full.
- [iFixit — Repairing and Upgrading Your Computer](catalogue-details.md#ifixit-repairing-and-upgrading-your-computer) — The public wiki is a chapter directory covering repair, components and upgrades, including legacy CRT and tape-drive topics. It is useful background, not a current model-specific upgrade procedure; compatibility and current safety guidance require separate checks.
- [Maiwa — Natural Dye Tutorials](catalogue-details.md#maiwa-natural-dye-tutorials) — The linked lessons teach fibre preparation and dye terminology, rather than one complete dye project. The Scouring enrollment page explicitly offers a no-charge course; enrollment was not performed. Use Maiwa’s separately listed public guide for a full process.
- [MIT — How to Make (Almost) Anything](catalogue-details.md#mit-how-to-make-almost-anything) — This is the public 2025 MIT class archive: a schedule, lectures and student documentation. It is not an independently packaged beginner course and does not include workshop access or guarantee complete instructions for every student project.
- [NASA / Stanford — spectroscopy curriculum (legacy kit)](catalogue-details.md#nasa-build-your-own-spectrograph) — Followed NASA’s link to Stanford Solar Center. Stanford explicitly says its spectrograph kits are no longer available; its study guides remain public. The original generic DIY-instrument description hid this materials barrier.
- [NMRA — Beginner Guide](catalogue-details.md#nmra-beginner-guide) — The NMRA guide explains scale, equipment selection, rolling stock, scenery and layout planning. Its opening chapter is a reference and roadmap, not one complete stand-alone construction project.
- [NODE — Make it Yourself](catalogue-details.md#node-make-it-yourself) — The free digital book is a discovery collection of links to original makers. It explicitly does not contain the project instructions itself; availability and equipment on destination sites vary.
- [Restarters Wiki — Repair Principles](catalogue-details.md#restarters-wiki-repair-principles) — The wiki explicitly teaches general repair principles and says it does not provide make/model repair instructions. Reading is public; an account is needed to contribute, not to read.
- [Sewing4Free — Bags](catalogue-details.md#sewing4free-bags) — Sewing4Free is a discovery index linking patterns on other sites. It does not itself establish the linked authors’ free-access or completeness claims; use the original pattern publisher.
- [The Restart Project — Restart at School](catalogue-details.md#the-restart-project-restart-at-school) — The free ten-week school curriculum explicitly expects educators and technical repair volunteers. It covers batteries and electronics safety; corrected the suggestion that the whole programme is ordinary unsupervised self-study.
- [TimeZone Watch School — free introductory essay](catalogue-details.md#timezone-watch-school-level-1-sample) — The public Level 1 sample links an introductory essay by Walt Odets; the remaining lesson titles are not public sample links. Corrected the claim that staged disassembly training was freely available.
- [Whittling Library](catalogue-details.md#whittling-library) — This is a curated selector of other creators’ carving videos, not an authored project course. Individual videos vary in completeness; follow the named original creator and check safety before choosing a project.
- [Wood &amp; Shop — Traditional Woodworking Index](catalogue-details.md#wood-shop-traditional-woodworking-index) — This is a broad woodworking navigation index mixing buying guides, tours, techniques and projects. It does not itself provide a complete restoration project; consult a specific free technique or the separately listed tool-refurbishing collection.
- [Woodland Scenics — Log Walls &amp; Lap Siding](catalogue-details.md#woodland-scenics-miniature-log-cabin) — The current page is titled Log Walls &amp; Lap Siding and describes a log-cabin demonstration using Scene-A-Rama Building &amp; Structure Kit SP4130. Retained as a product-specific technique reference; kit-independent complete instruction was not established.
